page.layout: One printed page: running head centred at top with page number at upper left; title heading below it; a framed engraving in the middle; a four-line verse epigram centred below the engraving; a signature-like word "ABYSVM" at lower right.

main_text.head: CERES ET BACCHVS EXcient Venerem.
main_text.p: [engraving: Ceres and Bacchus expel Venus; not transcribed as text]

p.i: Conserit Oenotrius solida bonus arte racemos, Brutorumq; ipsos stercore pinguat humo: Hinc simul ac gignunt generosa animantia vina, Exsiliunt veneris mente procace capræ.

page.notes: The engraving shows a winged-less female figure with a spear, a seated man drinking from a cask, a skeleton, and a figure with raised arms; it is an illustration, not printed text. The title line breaks as "EX-/cient". The word at lower right is printed in italic capitals and reads as ABYSVM. The verse first line may be read as "Conserit" with a long-s form; the initial letter is an ornamented C. Some letters in the verse are slightly blurred: "Oenotrius", "pinguat" and "procace" should be checked against the original.
